# OpenSheet-AI support

OpenSheet-AI is a public alpha. Use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/daichunghy/opensheet-ai/discussions) for first-run questions and [issues](https://github.com/daichunghy/opensheet-ai/issues) for reproducible contract or adapter defects.

The supported quickstart is the tagged GitHub clone followed by `npm ci` and `npm run verify`. The alpha does not claim Google Sheets, Excel desktop, formula recalculation, SEM, ERP, payment, or production integration.

Do not include credentials, customer workbooks, respondent data, or payment information. Security reports belong in [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/daichunghy/opensheet-ai/security/advisories/new).
